oracle-v1.data: engine self-play only (no user data); train seeds and test seeds are disjoint

serving.move_policy: blend: logit(P_net) + 0.5 * logit(P_heuristic), 1-ply determinized afterstate search

clairvoyance-v2.data: engine self-play only (no user data); train, calibration, test and arena seeds are disjoint; metrics use true game outcomes

serving.move_policy: blend: logit(P_net) + 0.5 * logit(P_heuristic), 1-ply determinized afterstate search

clairvoyance-v3.data: engine self-play only (no user data); train, calibration, test and arena seeds are disjoint; metrics use true game outcomes

serving.move_policy: blend: logit(P_net) + 0.3182 * logit(P_heuristic), 1-ply determinized afterstate search
serving.note: weight 0.25 was measured with calibration scale 0.632; after recalibration (scale 0.804) 0.3182 gives exactly the same move choices
